title: Store Hours
content: Meeple Harbor is open Monday through Thursday from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Friday and Saturday from 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM, and Sunday from 12:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Holiday hours may be different and will be posted on our website and front door.

title: Return Policy
content: Unopened games and merchandise may be returned within 14 days with the original receipt. Opened games cannot be returned unless they are defective or missing pieces.

title: Shipping Policy
content: Online orders are usually processed within two business days. Standard shipping typically takes three to seven business days, while local pickup orders are usually ready within 24 hours.

title: Game Warranty
content: Defective products may be exchanged within 60 days of purchase. Customers should bring the product, receipt, and all included pieces so our staff can inspect the issue.

title: Café Table Fees
content: Customers may use our board-game library for a $7 table fee per person. The fee covers up to four hours of play and is reduced to $4 when the customer purchases at least $15 in food or drinks.

title: Game Library Rules
content: Games from the café library must remain inside the building. Customers should return all cards, tokens, dice, and instructions to the correct box before checking out another game.

title: Private Event Reservations
content: Private rooms may be reserved for birthdays, team events, and gaming groups. Reservations require a $50 deposit, and cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance to receive a refund.

title: Harbor Quest Starter Set
content: The Harbor Quest Starter Set is a cooperative adventure game for two to four players. It is recommended for ages 10 and older and usually takes about 45 minutes to play.

title: Pocket Kingdoms Card Game
content: Pocket Kingdoms is a fast strategy card game for two players. Each match takes approximately 15 minutes, making it a good choice for beginners or customers looking for a quick game.

title: Damaged or Missing Pieces
content: Customers who purchase a game with damaged or missing pieces should contact us within 14 days. We will provide replacement pieces when available or exchange the game for another copy.
